correctness.rationale: Lagrange/Sylow subgroup classification yields trivial subgroup, normal rotation C_p, p order-two reflection subgroups and whole group. Their distinct cosets are respectively 2p singleton sets, two partition halves, p² cross-half pairs, and whole group; all p² cross pairs are realized as reflection cosets. Every pair is shattered using a 2-point coset or half plus distinct singletons. Same-half triples fail to realize a two-positive trace; mixed triples realize all 8 traces via global, half, cross, singleton and outside singleton. Four supports with 3 in one half contain an unshattered triple; 2+2 supports cannot realize a 3-positive cross-half trace except via whole group, which selects all four. Thus sharp cubic polynomial. Independent trace enumerations using exactly the concept families (not original verifier) for p=3,5,7 yield [1,6,15,18,0], [1,10,45,100,0], [1,14,91,294,0].
